purpose: Packaged browser-side SSH implementation; experimental developer distribution only.

runtimeSources.sourceModifications: src/session.c opt-in LIBSSH2_BROWSER_CALLBACK_IO excludes POSIX descriptor inspection/mutation/restoration, rejects synchronous socket wait with BAD_USE, and adds private terminal abort/free plus read-cancellation safety helpers. Abort marks DISCONNECTED, clears only inline outgoing packet state, then invokes existing allocation-owning session_free. src/misc.c makes default POSIX SEND/RECV callbacks return hard -ENOTSUP without retaining send/recv or Emscripten FS/SOCKFS. Actual I/O requires bridge callbacks. No crypto/auth changes. ssh/bridge.c supplies a separate private ABI for handshake, pinned authentication, direct-tcpip and the fixed current-user authorized_keys installer; session exec is never an options/message API.
None; build selects MBEDTLS_NO_PLATFORM_ENTROPY and MBEDTLS_ENTROPY_HARDWARE_ALT; bridge supplies WebCrypto entropy

buildToolchain.nonRootCache: The recipe copies the pinned SDK cache into its owned build directory unless EM_CACHE is explicitly supplied; the SDK installation is never chmod/chown modified.

reproduction.network: Only fetch requires network. Run compiler with network disabled. Generated runtime loads only packaged WASM.

patchReview: Only src/misc.c and src/session.c change under opt-in LIBSSH2_BROWSER_CALLBACK_IO.
Default POSIX send/recv hard fail ENOTSUP, descriptor startup/restoration are excluded, synchronous wait rejects BAD_USE; real I/O requires bridge callbacks.

Terminal abort requires closed native socket and quiesced JS operations, rejects remote listeners, marks disconnected and clears borrowed inline outgoing packet state only before existing allocation-owning session_free.
Read cancellation is safe only when channel read state is idle and no outgoing packet remains. No cryptographic/authentication algorithm edits.
artifactOrigin: Generated JS/WASM copied byte-for-byte from the pinned source-derived, network-disabled, non-root Emscripten 3.1.74 build after bridge freeze. The resolved compiler image digest is recorded above. The recipe verifies exact dependency commits, complete tracked patches, and all packaged license bytes against pinned dependency/toolchain files. Fixture credentials, build products and vendor git trees are not packaged.
installationAdmission: No browser identity/version gate. Firefox must admit a custom Experiment before addon code or its UI can execute; unsigned packages can be rejected by mandatory signing policy. Runtime then requires actual local capability self-check success. The separate firefox-experimental-updates.json feed never offers ordinary signed payloads; publication requires exact source payload and actual desktop plus Android capability-enabled evidence.
